entries.exact_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: four-frame 2D game animation sprite sheet, Demolitionist level 2 ATTACK.
Input image 1 is the authoritative level-2 idle character identity reference. Animate this exact character; preserve its polished softly painted 3D chibi proportions and material rendering.
Preserve the round olive enclosed helmet, TWO large circular dark glass goggles in thick round rims, one central round respirator with TWO round side filter pods, no exposed face. Preserve single olive cylindrical backpack canister and its cap and cyan bands. Preserve olive armored suit, cyan narrow illuminated seam lines, dark gloves, armored knees and boots, diagonal gold-capped grenade bandolier. Preserve exactly ONE two-handed revolver grenade launcher with one olive cylindrical ammunition drum and exactly ONE long dark gun barrel; do not make a multi-barrel weapon. Create a clean 2x2 sheet, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right: 1 READY: feet braced, launcher aimed right and slightly upward. 2 FIRE: small bright warm orange muzzle burst just beyond the single barrel, both hands firmly gripping, forward knee bent and body braced. 3 RECOIL: visible upper-body lean backward and launcher kick upward, knees absorbing force, no fire. 4 RECOVER: lowering the same launcher and returning body near frame 1 ready posture. These must be visibly different successive animation poses with a clear fire/recoil/recovery.
All figures face screen-right at the same slight three-quarter side view as the reference, camera fixed. Identical character body size in all four cells. Keep the full body, helmet, backpack, boots, barrel and muzzle flash wholly within each cell, at least 40 pixels of empty transparent clearance from every cell edge and a broad transparent gap between rows and columns. Position bodies consistently at common foot baseline, reserve flash width so no cropping. Four separate complete characters, no overlapping panels. Actual transparent RGBA background with no opaque background or fake checkerboard, no ground shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark. Preserve the reference identity exactly; no new armor or weapon redesign, no blue-to-orange level-3 armor changes.
